craft_notes: Sthāyin: substitutes — fourteen doors. Rows: catalogue kept whole. Rejected: trimming — killed: completeness. Read aloud: long roll.

lines: Master's frame, your frame, Her frame, the secret book,
hero's bowl, beads, spear, arrow-gear, pearl, gold —
wrought of blooms and scents and dear stuff, or the glass — worship as the sign.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra gurudehaṃ svadehaṃ śaktidehaṃ rahasyaśāstrapustakaṃ vīrapātram akṣasūtraṃ prāharaṇaṃ bāṇīyaṃ mauktikaṃ sauvarṇaṃ puṣpagandhadravyādihṛdyavastukṛtaṃ makuraṃ vā liṅgam arcayet
